# Mama Isa's Cooking School Venice

> > Authentic hands-on Italian cooking classes in Venice and Padua, led by award-winning Chef Isa, featuring traditional Venetian cuisine, pasta making, and regional specialties.

Mama Isa's Cooking School offers 35+ immersive cooking workshops in the Veneto region, with 25+ years of experience teaching authentic Italian culinary techniques. Featured in The New York Times, Forbes, Fox News, and Rick Steves, the school specializes in traditional Venetian recipes, fresh pasta, regional sauces, and cultural culinary experiences for individuals, couples, and groups.

## Key Topics

- Venetian cuisine
- Hands-on cooking classes
- Fresh pasta making
- Italian wine pairing
- Chef Isa
- Veneto region
- Traditional Italian sauces
- Risotto techniques
- Tiramisu
- Market tours
- Cicchetti
- Truffle cooking
- Jewish-Venetian heritage cuisine
- Prosecco DOCG
- English-language instruction

## Core Cooking Programs

- [Programs and Cooking Classes at Mama Isa's Cooking School Venice Italy](https://isacookinpadua.altervista.org/cooking-classes.html): 35+ hands-on Italian cooking classes & workshops in Venice/Padua region
- [Full Day Italian Cooking Class in Venice | Immersive Culinary Experience](https://isacookinpadua.altervista.org/full-day-cooking-class.html): Full-day immersive: appetizers, pasta, mains, desserts with Mama Isa
- [3-Day Intensive Cooking Course in Venice | Mama Isa's Culinary Program](https://isacookinpadua.altervista.org/three-day-cooking-classes.html): 3-day intensive: pasta, sauces, Venetian recipes with Mama Isa
- [Authentic Venetian Cooking Classes in Venice | Mama Isa's Cooking School](https://isacookinpadua.altervista.org/venetian-cooking-classes.html): Traditional Venetian cuisine: Cicchetti, seafood, market tour with Mama Isa

## Specialized Technique Classes

- [Authentic Risotto Cooking Classes in Venice | Master the Art of Italian Risotto](https://isacookinpadua.altervista.org/risotto-classes.html): Master risotto: rice varieties, toasting, mantecatura technique in Venice
- [Italian Sauce Cooking Classes in Venice | Master Authentic Pasta Sauces](https://isacookinpadua.altervista.org/sauce-classes.html): Authentic Italian sauces: ragù, pesto, marinara, mother sauces in Venice
- [Authentic Tiramisu Making Class in Venice | Learn the Real Italian Recipe](https://isacookinpadua.altervista.org/tiramisu.html): Traditional Tiramisu class: mascarpone, Savoiardi, artisan coffee
- [Cheese Making Classes and Cheese Tastings at Mama Isa's Cooking School Venice Italy](https://isacookinpadua.altervista.org/cheese-making.html): Ricotta making & wine-cheese pairing workshop in Venice

## Specialty & Seasonal Classes

- [Luxury Truffle Cooking Classes in Venice | Master the Italian Truffle](https://isacookinpadua.altervista.org/truffle-classes.html): Gourmet truffle cooking: cleaning, slicing & pairing black/white truffles
- [Jewish-Venetian Cooking Classes in Venice](https://isacookinpadua.altervista.org/jewish-italian-cooking-classes.html): Jewish-Venetian cuisine: Ghetto heritage & Cucina Ebraica classics
- [Christmas Cooking Classes at Mama Isa's Cooking School Venice Italy](https://isacookinpadua.altervista.org/christmas-cooking-classes.html): Seasonal Christmas cooking classes Dec 22-Jan 6 at Mama Isa's Venice
- [Brunch Cooking Classes in Venice Italy | Italian Style Brunch](https://isacookinpadua.altervista.org/brunch-cooking-classes.html): Italian brunch class: frittatas, artisan breads, pastries with Mama Isa
- [Romantic Cooking Classes for Couples in Venice | Private Culinary Experience](https://isacookinpadua.altervista.org/romantic-cooking-classes.html): Private couples class: romantic Italian cooking for honeymoons/anniversaries
